zh|ja|373e1244de71f1ff8439.text: 使用调查数据解释引入 AI 代理的 10 个挑战！实施前后的墙壁和解决方案

zh|ja|5ed14c79d23fdfe11dd9.text: 引入人工智能代理的挑战根据阶段的不同而变化，从引入前的“目的、数据和人力资源”到引入后的“合作、准确性和保留”。有很多人被管理层委托考虑，但却无法制定计划，因为他们看不到自己会在哪里遇到麻烦。在很多情况下，我们在开始 PoC 后发现数据不足或缺乏实地合作。 Gartner 预测，到 2027 年底，超过 40% 的 AI 代理相关项目将被取消。如果你在不了解问题的情况下就开始运行，你的公司也会站在同一边。

en|ja|373e1244de71f1ff8439.text: Explaining 10 challenges for introducing AI agents using survey data! Walls and solutions before and after implementation

en|ja|5ed14c79d23fdfe11dd9.text: The challenges for introducing an AI agent change depending on the stage, from "purpose, data, and human resources" before introduction to "cooperation, accuracy, and retention" after introduction. There are many people who have been entrusted with consideration by management, but are unable to formulate a plan because they cannot see where they will run into trouble. There are many cases where we discover inadequacies in data or lack of cooperation on the ground after starting a PoC. Gartner predicts that over 40% of AI agent-related projects will be canceled by the end of 2027. If you start running without knowing the issues, your company will also be on the same side.

zh|ja|74c65372e69d0030d38c.text: 引入AI代理有什么效果？ 8 种效应的解释、公司示例以及如何衡量它们

zh|ja|d91330dc564d44434c2f.text: 引入人工智能代理的效果不仅仅是减少工作时间和成本，还可以稳定响应质量并改善销售和客户体验。但也有很多负责人被管理层问到“如果加上的话会更好吗？改善多少？”，无法用证据解释其效果，从而结束审批程序。普华永道 2026 年的一项调查显示，只有 9% 的日本公司发现生成式人工智能产生的结果“明显超出预期”。如果在没有决定效果类型以及如何测量效果的情况下引入，人工智能代理可能会得到相同的结果。

en|ja|74c65372e69d0030d38c.text: What are the effects of introducing AI agents? Explanation of 8 effects, company examples, and how to measure them

en|ja|d91330dc564d44434c2f.text: The effects of introducing an AI agent go beyond reducing work time and costs to stabilizing response quality and improving sales and customer experience. However, there are many people in charge who are asked by management, ``What will be better if we add it, and how much will it improve?'' and are unable to explain the effects with evidence and end their approval process. In a 2026 survey by PwC, only 9% of Japanese companies found that generative AI produced results that "significantly exceeded expectations." If introduced without deciding on the type of effect and how to measure it, AI agents will likely have the same results.
